SFTP is disabled on Savannah and only legacy scp -O works, so the assumed SFTP transport is unavailable
evidence.quote: Starting with OpenSSH 9.0, scp uses the SFTP protocol by default. As of 2025-01, SFTP is disabled on Savannah. Please add the -O option to scp command line if you use OpenSSH 9.0 or later:

evidence.proved: uploads require a registered SSH public key tied to a Savannah account
evidence.quote: The authentication method to use with scp is SSH public key (one of those that you registered in your Savannah account).
